title: Flood Claim Intake and the Coverage Period — NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
**What is a flood.** A claim under the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) is taken for direct physical loss by or from flood — a general and temporary condition of partial or complete inundation of two or more acres of normally dry land or of two or more properties, at least one of which is the insured's, from overflow of inland or tidal waters, unusual and rapid accumulation or runoff of surface waters, mudflow, or collapse of land along a shore caused by erosion or undermining from flood.

**Coverage period.** A claim is covered only when the date of loss falls on or after the date the coverage took effect and before the policy's cancellation effective date or term end, a loss in renewal grace being covered only if the renewal premium is then received inside the grace period. The date of loss is the caller's to state, and it is set against the effective date, term end and any cancellation effective date on the policy record.

**First notice and adjusting.** The claim number is assigned at first notice, and the assigned adjuster contacts the insured within the tier's adjuster contact standard in elapsed hours under Tidemark's servicing standard.

**Adjuster reports.** Every adjuster report records the measured building loss at replacement cost and at actual cash value and the contents loss at actual cash value. A final report supersedes earlier reports on the claim, and a supplemental report filed after it supersedes it for the coverages it measures.

## Coverage-period cases (hypothetical dates)

| Coverage took effect | Term end | Cancellation effective | Date of loss | Covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 1 April next year | — | 1 April | yes — on the effective date |
| 1 April | 1 April next year | — | 31 March | no — before the coverage took effect |
| 1 April | 1 April next year | 10 October | 10 October | no — not before the cancellation effective date |
| 1 April | 1 April next year | — | 5 April next year, renewal premium received inside grace | yes |
